reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The cmd_offset c_int owns the byte offset at the left edge of the visible command text, initially zero; it is distinct from display-column counts.
owner_creation.invariant: Visible byte origin is not a terminal column value.
limitations: cmd_offset is an offset into the current command buffer.

aliases_escapes.analysis: cmd_home and scrolling derive pointers into cmdbuf from the cmd_offset scalar; copying the offset does not validate the selected UTF sequence or current text owner.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Offset-derived pointers require current command text bounds.
limitations: A retained offset requires revalidation after command-buffer replacement.

callback_targets.analysis: Scroll logic calls step_char and repaint/output directly to compute a new visible origin; the cmd_offset integer stores no callback address.
callback_targets.invariant: Offset computation borrows formatting state synchronously.
limitations: Display navigation consumes the offset synchronously without a stored callback.

invalidation.analysis: Reset/kill sets cmd_offset to zero and lshift/rshift replaces it after character stepping; later in-place edits can change what the same numeric offset denotes.
invalidation.invariant: Command edits can invalidate the meaning of an old offset.

mutation_commit.analysis: Scrolling assigns cmd_offset from a same-array pointer difference, separately from cp/column updates and repaint.
mutation_commit.invariant: Offset updates must remain coherent with cursor state.

release_pair.analysis: No release belongs to the cmd_offset scalar; changing the visible origin does not free prefix bytes or shrink the fixed array.
release_pair.invariant: Scrolling is not a buffer-owner retirement operation.
limitations: Resetting cmd_offset does not free the command allocation.

error_cleanup.analysis: Reconstructing cmdbuf+cmd_offset relies on a current in-bounds byte offset; no typed invalid-offset result repairs a stale text/layout relationship.
error_cleanup.invariant: Numeric offset alone cannot prove a valid substring.

signals_handoff.analysis: cmd_offset participates in shared redraw state without a guard permitting handler-time scroll or editor reentry.
signals_handoff.invariant: Visible-origin mutation requires controlled editor sequencing.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

src/signal.rs.relationship: terminate calls quit at src/signal.rs:83-85 rather than modifying cmd_offset. Any cleanup route that could invalidate this offset requires a further editor call trace, which is not claimed here.
